1.web: To you I do lift up my eyes, you who sit in the heavens.
1.asv: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.

2.web: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes look to Yahweh, our God, until he has mercy on us.
2.asv: Behold, as the eyes of servantslook unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyeslook unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.

3.web: Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
3.asv: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

4.web: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
4.asv: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.
